entries.intent: A returning trader gets back into their wallet
The trader opens the BTC market they want to trade
The trader is looking at the laddered-order ticket, ready to choose a price range
The trader starts from a clean slate, betting the market rises
The trader splits the ladder across two rungs
The trader commits a size so the ticket is complete and placeable
The trader places the cheapest rung of their upward bet safely below the market
The trader keeps the far rung below the market too, so the whole ladder should rest
Nothing is wrong with this ladder, so the trader is left alone
The trader stretches only the far rung past the market, so part of the ladder would fill on the spot
The trader is told that only part of their order would fill immediately, not all of it

output.text: Part of your price range is above current price

entries.intent: Bring the price range and the caution beneath it into plain sight
Show the trader being told only part of their ladder would fill at once
The trader lifts the near rung above the market too, putting every rung on the wrong side
Now the whole order would fill immediately, and the wording escalates to say so

output.text: Your price range is above current price

entries.intent: Bring the price range and the caution beneath it into plain sight
Show the trader being told their whole upward ladder would fill at once
The trader changes their mind and bets the market falls instead
Those same prices are perfectly sensible for a downward bet, so the warning clears itself
The trader sets the lower bound of the downward ladder under the market
The trader keeps the upper bound under the market too, so every rung is on the wrong side
The trader gets the mirrored warning for a downward bet that would fill on the spot

output.text: Your price range is below current price

entries.intent: Bring the price range and the caution beneath it into plain sight
Show the trader the mirrored caution for a downward ladder that would fill at once
The warning is advice, not a veto: the trader can still go ahead and place the order
